chunks: And through his chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
I and Ali were created from one light.

key_terms.صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ: Peace be upon him and his family

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the hadith stating that the Prophet and Ali were created from one light?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* articulates the Shia doctrine of *Nur Muhammad* (Light of the Prophet), positing that the Prophet and Imam Ali share a primordial, undivided essence created before the physical universe. It underscores their ontological unity and serves as a foundational proof for the spiritual authority (*Wilayah*) of the Ahl al-Bayt, distinguishing their creation from that of other beings.
